verdict.rationale: Alloy is a fraud, KYC and AML platform, so suspicious-activity reporting is a fair axis for it. The pack shows transaction monitoring that can "generate alerts or investigations," but nothing documents preparing a suspicious-activity report, using jurisdiction-specific templates or formats, or compiling case evidence into a regulatory filing. Alert and investigation generation is an adjacent capability and earns no credit toward the reporting story.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can prepare a jurisdiction-specific suspicious-activity report from case evidence
